title: Re-enable bolt_on_stack golden test
description: The bolt_on_stack golden test is commented out because the script indices depend on deterministic player ordering from RandomUtil.setSeed(42) + DeterministicUUID. With the shufflePlayers revert (no longer sorting players by name in skipInitShuffling mode), the player order may differ between runs. The test needs to use id-based selection instead of fragile index-based selection, or the script needs to be regenerated and verified stable. The golden file itself is correct — Lightning Bolt on the stack targeting Opponent on T1.
